## `get_secret_to_file`

Write a secret to a new mode-0600 local file. The destination must be new, and the secret value is never returned.

**Operation type:** <mark style="background-color: green;">Write</mark>

**Annotations:** read-only `false`, destructive `false`, idempotent `false`, open-world `true`

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "cluster": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "title": "Cluster"
    },
    "destination_file": {
      "title": "Destination File",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "key": {
      "title": "Key",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "org": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "title": "Org"
    },
    "project": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "title": "Project"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "key",

  ],
  "title": "get_secret_to_fileArguments",

}
```
